name: Methuselah
title: The Longest Life in the Bible
summary: Methuselah was the son of Enoch and the grandfather of Noah. He is best known for having lived longer than any other person in the Bible, a total of 969 years. His death occurred in the same year that the flood came upon the earth.

keyEvents.title: The Birth of Methuselah
keyEvents.description: Methuselah was born when his father Enoch was 65 years old. After Methuselah's birth, Enoch walked with God for 300 years.

keyEvents.title: Methuselah Has a Son Named Lamek
keyEvents.description: When Methuselah was 187 years old, he had a son named Lamek, who later became the father of Noah.

keyEvents.title: The Longest Life
keyEvents.description: Methuselah lived 969 years, the longest life recorded in the Bible. He witnessed many generations and major changes in human history.

keyEvents.title: Part of Christ's lineage
keyEvents.description: Methuselah is mentioned in Jesus' genealogy in Luke, as part of the line from Adam to Christ through Noah and Seth.
